verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI privacy docs say its AI features are opt-in and do not store or train on customer data, with contractual no-training terms for its Anthropic and OpenAI subprocessors. An organization can block all AI features, but only by emailing support. That gives a no-retention posture by design rather than user-facing retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: self-serve retention settings, user- or org-initiated data deletion/export controls, documented retention periods for non-AI platform data, and independent corroboration.
